rules.rule:
AI Video Factory Operational Constitution (Python Enforcement):
1. RULE 118 (Zero-Mock Data): NEVER allow synthetic/mock data, hardcoded fake analytics (views, CTR, AVD, retention). Missing metrics MUST be None.
2. RULE 119 (Temp Isolation): Temporary sandboxes and test artifacts MUST reside strictly in /tmp/ and be cleaned up on exit. Never pollute project root.
3. RULE 120 (Audio-Subtitle Millisecond Precision): Whisper timestamps and TTS sync MUST preserve millisecond precision without coarse rounding.
4. RULE 125 (Single Truth & Zero-Ghost): FORBID shadow bypass scripts, duplicate versions, and .bak files. Docstrings must match actual implementation.
5. RULE 126/127 (Runtime Integrity): All file operations MUST explicitly specify encoding='utf-8'. Catch specific exceptions; NEVER use bare 'except:' or silent 'pass'. Always use 'with' context managers for files, sockets, locks.
6. RULE 128 (Zero Semantic Bias): FORBID hardcoding episode-specific content (topic names, local characters, era details) into core contracts, schemas, or prompt templates. Use generic patterns ^[A-Z]{2}_EP\d{4}_[a-z0-9_]+$.
7. RULE 134 (Pre-Sync Consistency): Configuration constants, timeout thresholds, and error codes must remain strictly consistent across contracts, tests, and CLI runners.
8. Concurrency & Subprocesses: Every subprocess invocation MUST have an explicit timeout, watchdog, and exit cleanup to prevent zombie processes.

AI Video Factory Remotion & Web Visual Rules:
1. Anti-OOM & Memory Leak: Release heavy image/video buffers promptly. Do not accumulate large binary buffers or canvases in React state.
2. Remotion Lifecycle: Every 'delayRender' MUST be paired with a guaranteed 'continueRender' in a try/finally block to prevent renderer deadlocks.
3. Safe Zone Compliance: Overlay elements, subtitles, and badges must remain within 1080x1920 (Vertical) or 1920x1080 (Horizontal) platform safe zones.
4. Strict Types: Avoid 'any' types; strictly validate subtitle timestamps and scene duration props.

AI Video Factory Shell Scripting Rules:
1. Robustness: Always start with 'set -euo pipefail'.
2. Cleanup: Register 'trap' handlers on EXIT/ERR to clean up /tmp artifacts.
3. Quoting: Double quote all variables to prevent word splitting and glob injection.
